run_delete_old_night_packages: run the script to remove old conda nightly builds for aihabitat-nightly/habitat-sim
run_login_to_anaconda: run anaconda login with username and password via the script
run_list_versions: run anaconda show to list available versions of aihabitat-nightly/habitat-sim
run_remove_versions: run anaconda remove to delete old nightly build versions keeping only the latest
run_parse_versions_with_regex: run regex parsing to extract version strings matching the pattern d.d.d.yyyy.mm.dd
